description:
Get a single task. ticket_id accepts UUID, ticket slug, or a full browser task URL (property optional when ticket_id is a URL).

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// Fetch one task by its ticket_id within a property.
{"ticketId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","property":"sc-domain:example.com"}
```
name: get_task
title: Task detail
